# TruffleHog path exclusions — passed as `--exclude-paths` by
# .github/workflows/ci.yml (see the "Check for secrets" step there).
#
# Format: one regular expression per line, matched against the file path.
# Keep this list short and justified; every entry is a place where a real
# leaked secret could hide, so anything added here must be a file that no
# human writes by hand.
#
# Generated dependency lockfiles. These are written by npm/cargo, are reviewed
# as diffs by Dependabot, and are the dominant source of false positives in
# this repository:
#
#   - evm/package-lock.json tripped the Box detector. Its reported location
#     (line 719) is the literal string `"license": "MIT",`; the only "box"
#     substrings in the file are the package names @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox,
#     boxen and cli-boxes, and the file contains no JWT, no credential-bearing
#     URL and no 32-character lowercase-alnum token anywhere in its 9388 lines.
#
# Trivy still scans these files for known-vulnerable dependencies in the same
# job, so excluding them from secret scanning does not drop them from review.
package-lock\.json$
(^|/)yarn\.lock$
(^|/)pnpm-lock\.yaml$
(^|/)Cargo\.lock$
#
# Hand-written test fixtures that assert credential-bearing URIs are REJECTED.
# Narrow exception to the machine-written-only rule above, scoped to these
# two files by exact-path regexes (nothing else is excluded):
#
#   - solana/test/config.test.mjs: asserts validateMetadataUri() rejects
#     a credential-bearing Arweave metadata URI (placeholder user/password).
#   - amity/test/holder-verification.test.mjs: asserts the challenge builder
#     rejects a credential-bearing universe URL on the example testnet host.
#     (The fixtures themselves are quoted in the test files, not here: this
#     file is scanned too, so writing the literal URIs here would re-create
#     the finding this entry exists to suppress.)
#
# Both are placeholder credentials on example hosts, in tests whose whole
# point is that such URIs must be rejected; TruffleHog verified 0 secrets
# in scheduled run 43695925702. The inline `trufflehog:ignore` tags already
# on those lines cannot suppress the finding: the schedule scan covers full
# git history, and the URIs were introduced in ce9563b (2026-09-23) and
# 896fcca (2026-09-24) before the tags were added in 02ce959 (2026-09-27),
# so the introducing diffs still trip the URI detector on every weekly run.
^solana/test/config\.test\.mjs$
^amity/test/holder-verification\.test\.mjs$
